recommendation: Prefer Solution A (receive-fixed swap) when the fund wants duration with minimal cash outlay and can manage CSA/counterparty terms. Prefer Solution B (physical gilts) when the mandate forbids derivatives or when collateral and counterparty risk dominate. Both are sized to the same DV01, so parallel ±100 bp P&L is close; the commercial choice is about cash, credit, and governance—not the first-order rate hedge.
